description: Hand-labelled gold lineage cases. Labels were written by the author from SQL semantics BEFORE running the parser. Edge notation: col:<src.col>><dst.col>:<direct|derived>[@role]; ind:<src.col>><dataset>:<role>; tbl:<src>><dst>. 'warn' lists warning kinds that must appear; 'clean' means no warnings may appear. This is a regression corpus, not an independent benchmark.
